definitions.gloss: business; errand; personal matter to attend to
definitions.explanation: Something one needs to do or take care of. A polite, somewhat vague way of referring to personal business or errands without specifying details.

examples.japanese: {所用|しょよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かけます→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
{所用|しょよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I cannot attend the meeting due to a personal matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{所用|しょよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けたい→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I have errands in the afternoon, so I want to finish my work in the morning.

notes:
A polite, somewhat formal word used to refer to business or errands without going into specifics. Convenient for declining invitations or explaining absences without revealing personal details.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所用|しょよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out on business
- {所用|しょよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧: due to personal business
- {所用|しょよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧: because I have something to do
- {所用|しょよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to take care of one's business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧: errand, something to do — more casual and everyday
- ⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧: matter of business — more formal, often used in business contexts
- ⟦{私用|しよう}→私用：00459_shiyou⟧: personal business — specifically emphasizes it is private, not work-related

USAGE:
{所用|しょよう} is vaguer and more polite than ⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧. It is often used in formal or business settings when one does not wish to explain the specific reason for an absence.
